beats.label: S1 · Riddler's trap
beats.text: Harley breaks free of Joker after Riddler's trap reveals he'd let her die for Batman; Ivy staged the whole thing to make her see it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The founding rupture. Everything Harley does for the rest of the series flows from this break.

beats.label: S1 · Building a crew
beats.text: Chasing Legion of Doom respect, Harley builds a crew of castoffs — Doctor Psycho, Clayface, King Shark, later ex-agent Sy Borgman.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the ensemble that carries every future season.

beats.label: S1 · Kite Man and Joker kiss
beats.text: Ivy reluctantly starts dating Kite Man; Harley's one-night reunion with Joker gets her cut off by her own crew when the news catches them kissing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the Ivy–Kite Man relationship and Ivy's buried resentment of Harley, both key to S2.

beats.label: S1 · Bensonhurst
beats.text: After defeating and disowning her own parents over a bounty on her head, Harley returns to Gotham to save Ivy from the Scarecrow.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements Ivy, not blood, as Harley's family — the emotional pivot the finale pays off.

beats.label: S1 · Poisoned reservoir
beats.text: Scarecrow poisons Gotham's water with Ivy's pheromones, turning the city's trees into killers; Ivy admits she resents Harley for picking Joker over her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First direct airing of the Ivy-loves-Harley thread that drives S2, delivered under the season's biggest disaster.

beats.label: S1 · Gotham falls
beats.text: The Queen of Fables traps the Justice League in her book; Joker's tower attack levels Gotham and he kills Ivy in front of Harley.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the post-apocalyptic Gotham that all of S2 takes place in.

beats.label: S1 · Ivy resurrects, Joker acidified
beats.text: A resurrected Ivy drops Joker in acid to save Harley; Batman vanishes in the rubble and a 'normal' Joker crawls out of the acid laughing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every S2 opening state — no Batman, no Joker, ruined Gotham, Ivy alive — is set here.

cliffhanger.text: Gotham is a smoking ruin, Batman has disappeared into the debris, and a mysteriously 'normal' Joker just crawled out of the vat that was meant to end him. Harley, Ivy, and the crew are alive but standing in the wreckage with no allies and no plan.
questions: Who fills the power vacuum in a lawless Gotham with Batman gone?
What does a Joker with no memory of himself become?
How long can Ivy keep pretending Kite Man is what she wants?

characters.name: Harley Quinn
characters.line: Broke free of Joker for good and built her own crew; standing in Gotham's ruins closer than ever to Ivy.

characters.name: Poison Ivy
characters.line: Harley's anchor and best friend; killed by Joker and resurrected in time to save Harley, still dating Kite Man.

characters.name: The Joker
characters.line: Dropped in acid by Ivy after his Gotham takeover; crawls out of the rubble seemingly ordinary, still laughing.

characters.name: Kite Man
characters.line: Ivy's earnest, dim boyfriend; devoted to her and oblivious to the tension with Harley.

characters.name: Doctor Psycho
characters.line: Misogynist telepath the Legion cast out; loyal to Harley's crew only because they gave him a seat at the table.

characters.name: Clayface
characters.line: Shapeshifting Gotham thespian; earnest and often the source of the crew's problems.

characters.name: King Shark
characters.line: Massive shark-man of royal underwater blood; the crew's muscle and its softest heart.

characters.name: Frank the Plant
characters.line: Ivy's sentient talking houseplant and sarcastic confidant to her and Harley.

characters.name: Commissioner Gordon
characters.line: Gotham PD boss unravelling as the city collapses; still convinced Batman will return.

characters.name: Batman / Bruce Wayne
characters.line: Vanishes into the rubble of Joker's tower; presumed lost as the season ends.

beats.label: S2 · No man's land
beats.text: Gotham is exiled from the US as a no man's land; the Injustice League — Penguin, Riddler, Bane, Two-Face, Freeze — carve it up while Harley picks them off.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the season's playing board and Harley's arc as an emergent power in the ruins.

beats.label: S2 · Bat Family reforms
beats.text: Barbara Gordon becomes Batgirl and rallies her father; Bruce recovers with Alfred, dons a new Batsuit, and asks Batgirl to hold the line.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Bat Family Harley eventually joins — Batgirl is a load-bearing recurring character from here on.

beats.label: S2 · Proposal and bachelorette
beats.text: Kite Man proposes to Ivy; she says yes to bury her feelings for Harley, then sleeps with her twice on the bachelorette weekend.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The relationship pivot the whole season turns on.

beats.label: S2 · Joker restored
beats.text: An amnesiac Joker resurfaces as a bartender in love with a nurse named Bethany; Harley pushes him back into the acid to restore his memories.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cleans up the S1 cliffhanger and puts Joker back on the board.

beats.label: S2 · Parademons and Psycho's exit
beats.text: Harley borrows a Parademon army from Darkseid but relents when Ivy makes her see she's gone too far; Doctor Psycho quits the crew in disgust.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Psycho from ally to enemy for the rest of the season and beyond.

beats.label: S2 · The sex tape
beats.text: A vengeful Psycho brainwashes Ivy to kill Harley; Harley kisses her free, and Psycho's dying act broadcasts their bachelorette sex to all of Gotham.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Forces the Harley–Ivy secret out publicly and directly triggers the wedding blowup.

beats.label: S2 · Wedding and getaway
beats.text: Kite Man calls off the wedding after realising Ivy only agreed to bury her feelings for Harley; the two escape Gordon together, kissing as they drive off.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The end state that opens S3: Harley and Ivy officially together, on the run.

cliffhanger.text: Harley and Ivy are together and speeding out of Gotham as Gordon rages behind them, a jilted Kite Man watches the wreckage, and a fully restored Joker is loose in the city. Nothing about their new relationship has been tested outside the getaway car.
questions: Can Harley and Ivy make a real relationship work once the adrenaline fades?
What does Kite Man do next now that Ivy has left him at the altar?
With Batman on the mend, who runs Gotham while Harley and Ivy are gone?

characters.name: Harley Quinn
characters.line: Officially with Ivy and on the run from Gordon; her crew is intact and her Joker chapter is over.

characters.name: Poison Ivy
characters.line: Walked out on Kite Man mid-wedding and left Gotham with Harley; done pretending she doesn't love her.

characters.name: Kite Man
characters.line: Called off the engagement after realising Ivy never loved him; publicly humiliated by the exposed affair.

characters.name: The Joker
characters.line: Restored by a second acid dip; back to villainy while quietly maintaining his relationship with Bethany.

characters.name: Bruce Wayne / Batman
characters.line: Recovering hero back in a new Batsuit; content to let Batgirl carry the load while he heals.

characters.name: Barbara Gordon / Batgirl
characters.line: Rising vigilante her father knows about; the Bat Family's most active field member.

characters.name: Commissioner Gordon
characters.line: Still commissioner and still seeking public glory; Harley slipped his wedding trap despite Two-Face's coaching.

characters.name: Doctor Psycho
characters.line: Cast out of the crew after his betrayal; broadcast Harley and Ivy's sex tape to all of Gotham as revenge.

characters.name: Clayface
characters.line: Crew mainstay and Harley's loyal shapeshifter through the wedding chaos.

characters.name: King Shark
characters.line: Crew muscle, now openly and amicably married to Tabitha in an arranged union.

beats.label: S3 · Eat, Bang, Kill and home
beats.text: Fresh off the 'Eat, Bang, Kill Tour', Harley and Ivy return to Gotham; Ivy plans to terraform the city into a paradise like her lost garden Edin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's ambition — Ivy's terraforming dream — that everything else pushes against.

beats.label: S3 · Frank powered up, Frank taken
beats.text: Nightwing rejoins the Bat Family; Ivy's serum accident gives Frank legs and telekinesis, and Bruce kidnaps him to resurrect his dead parents.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Nightwing (essential to S4) and sets up the Bruce/Frank abduction that drives the second half.

beats.label: S3 · Joker mayor
beats.text: Joker runs for mayor to help his stepkids and wins fair; Gordon drops out after seeing Joker has genuinely changed, then loses his job.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reshapes Gotham's political order into what Harley and Ivy inherit at season's end.

beats.label: S3 · Mind trip and apocalypse
beats.text: Harley enters Bruce's mind to save Frank and comes to respect Batman; Bruce still casts his spell, unleashing a plant-zombie apocalypse.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mind trip is the seed of Harley's Bat Family turn; the apocalypse is the season's climax.

beats.label: S3 · Ivy chooses Harley over Eden
beats.text: Ivy hijacks the zombie apocalypse to terraform Gotham, then reverses everything to save an infected Harley — quietly bitter about the sacrifice.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ivy giving up her dream for Harley is the buried resentment that drives her S4 arc.

beats.label: S3 · Sides chosen
beats.text: Mayor Joker jails Bruce for endangering Gotham; Harley officially joins the Bat Family while Ivy accepts Luthor's offer to run the Legion of Doom.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Places every major player on the S4 board: Harley hero, Ivy CEO, Bruce prisoner, Joker mayor.

cliffhanger.text: Harley is a full Bat Family member and Ivy is about to walk into the Legion of Doom's top office — hero and villain, living together, for the first time. Bruce has surrendered himself to Joker's new GCPD.
questions: Can Harley and Ivy stay together when their jobs put them on opposite sides?
Is Ivy really over her buried terraforming dream, or just deferring it?
How does Gotham cope with Bruce Wayne behind bars and Joker running City Hall?

characters.name: Harley Quinn
characters.line: Newly minted Bat Family member under Batgirl; in love with Ivy but afraid of drifting apart from her.

characters.name: Poison Ivy
characters.line: Legion of Doom's incoming CEO after quietly sacrificing her terraforming dream to save Harley.

characters.name: Bruce Wayne / Batman
characters.line: Surrendered himself to Joker's GCPD after almost destroying Gotham to resurrect his parents.

characters.name: The Joker
characters.line: Elected mayor of Gotham after a genuine turn to fatherhood; running the city and dismantling the old GCPD.

characters.name: Barbara Gordon / Batgirl
characters.line: Leader of the Bat Family in Bruce's absence and Harley's mentor.

characters.name: Nightwing
characters.line: Returned to the Bat Family; on friendly terms with Harley by season's end.

characters.name: Commissioner Gordon
characters.line: Lost the mayoral race and his job when Joker dismantled the GCPD; adrift and out of work.

characters.name: Frank the Plant
characters.line: Ivy's sentient plant, now walking on legs and wielding telekinesis after her serum accident.

characters.name: Clayface
characters.line: Starring as Thomas Wayne in a hit biopic no one believes he actually acted in.

characters.name: King Shark
characters.line: Son of the late Shark King; unintentionally killed his brother Prince Shark in a fight over selling the kingdom to Ocean Master.

beats.label: S4 · New jobs, first kill
beats.text: Ivy takes over the Legion of Doom; Harley trains with the Bat Family and, on her first hero mission, kills Professor Pyg — earning a demotion.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Harley's hero–killer contradiction that the whole season interrogates.

beats.label: S4 · Talia arrives
beats.text: Talia al Ghul arrives, befriending Ivy while quietly gutting Wayne Enterprises; Harley invents celebrity 'Hargret' to belong in the villain world.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Talia, whose secret resurrection project is the season's real hidden engine.

beats.label: S4 · Ivy's PR spiral
beats.text: Ivy's PR team the Jons make her a star while she neglects Harley, her mentees, and Frank; she kills them, but the damage to her relationships is done.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Drives the couple's communication breakdown that becomes the season's real problem.

beats.label: S4 · Nightwing dead, future warning
beats.text: Nightwing turns up murdered; a time trip to 2048 shows Gotham destroyed by an apocalypse Harley and Ivy failed to stop by talking to each other.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mystery driving the back half and the diagnosis of the couple's core failure.

beats.label: S4 · Six-day apocalypse
beats.text: Luthor uses Volcana to thicken the ozone and block out the Sun, plunging Gotham into a six-day apocalypse; Ivy quits the Legion and joins Harley to blow up every corporate villain.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ivy's break from the Legion and the destruction of the villain establishment — massive board reset.

beats.label: S4 · The sleepwalking killer
beats.text: A clone of Harley reveals Harley herself killed Nightwing while sleepwalking; Harley destroys the clone, then Joker paralyses Batgirl with a gunshot.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Answers the murder mystery and drives Harley out of the Bat Family.

beats.label: S4 · Sirens and Lazarus
beats.text: Harley, Ivy, Batgirl and Catwoman form the Gotham City Sirens; Talia secretly steals Nightwing's corpse and resurrects him in a Lazarus Pit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: New team on one side, a resurrected killer loose on the other — the setup for S5.

cliffhanger.text: The Sirens have just formed and Harley has finally accepted both halves of herself, but Nightwing's grave is empty and only Talia knows he's alive again in a Lazarus Pit. Batgirl is paralysed, Bruce is Batman again, and the villain corporate order lies in rubble.
questions: What is Nightwing after being dragged back through a Lazarus Pit?
Can Harley and Ivy build a life without the Bat Family or the Legion propping them up?
With every major villain org destroyed, who tries to fill that vacuum next?

characters.name: Harley Quinn
characters.line: Quit the Bat Family after her sleepwalking self was revealed as Nightwing's killer; founding member of the new Sirens.

characters.name: Poison Ivy
characters.line: Quit the Legion of Doom and blew up its HQ with Harley; a founding Siren.

characters.name: Bruce Wayne / Batman
characters.line: Released from prison and back in the cowl; publicly a hero again.

characters.name: Barbara Gordon / Batgirl
characters.line: Paralysed by Joker but still the Sirens' tech backbone; a founding member.

characters.name: Nightwing
characters.line: Killed by sleepwalking Harley; his corpse secretly stolen by Talia and revived in a Lazarus Pit.

characters.name: Talia al Ghul
characters.line: Sat inside Wayne Enterprises to strip it while quietly resurrecting Nightwing for her own reasons.

characters.name: The Joker
characters.line: Back to villainy after his mayoralty; publicly claimed Nightwing's murder before being disproven, then paralysed Batgirl.

characters.name: Catwoman
characters.line: Rejoined Harley and Ivy as a founding Gotham City Siren.

characters.name: Alfred Pennyworth
characters.line: Sent to Arkham after a botched robbery he staged trying to reunite with Bruce.

characters.name: Frank the Plant
characters.line: Still Ivy's stabilising presence after her Legion of Doom fallout.

beats.label: S5 · Metropolis move
beats.text: A year on, the Sirens have collapsed; Harley and Ivy move to Metropolis, where Ivy leads Lena Luthor's Green Initiative and Brainiac quietly watches from orbit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Wholesale relocation of the show and introduction of the two antagonists driving the season.

beats.label: S5 · Woodrue returns
beats.text: Ivy tries to kill her old college abuser Woodrue; he returns as the Floronic Man, Harley finishes him with a chainsaw, and Ivy is caught hiding the truth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the season's honesty-in-the-relationship theme and the first real test of it.

beats.label: S5 · Lena and Brainiac
beats.text: Lena is secretly working with Brainiac but shields Harley and Ivy after they impress her; Brainiac erases their memory of ever being aboard his ship.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the season's real villain architecture — Lena driving, Brainiac reluctantly enabling.

beats.label: S5 · Alfred's revenge
beats.text: A vengeful Alfred hires the resurrected Dick Grayson, now Red X, to kill Harley, Ivy and Joker for their crimes; he's defeated at a dinner party.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes out the S4 Lazarus dangler and turns Alfred into a full villain, freeing the season to focus on Lena.

beats.label: S5 · Frank killed, Frankette taken
beats.text: Clayface's musical about Brainiac earns him public sympathy; Lena secretly stabs Frank to death, then takes his newborn daughter Frankette from Ivy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's real emotional stab — Frank dead, Lena revealed as the true threat.

beats.label: S5 · City in a bottle
beats.text: Lena betrays Brainiac and shrinks Metropolis in a bottle to prove herself to her brother Lex; Harley and Ivy break Lex out of prison to use against her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Escalation to the season's central catastrophe.

beats.label: S5 · Brainiac's peace
beats.text: Harley reconciles the Luthor siblings, who then turn on her; Brainiac shrinks them, makes peace with his grief, and crashes into his lost home planet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves every arc — Luthors defeated, Brainiac reconciled, Harley and Ivy safe.

cliffhanger.text: Metropolis is restored and physically relocated next to Gotham; the Luthors are shrunk inside Frankette, Brainiac is dead, and Harley and Ivy have reaffirmed their love. They head off into the night for whatever's next.
questions: What adventure do Harley and Ivy pick when nobody's forcing their hand?
How does a Metropolis parked next door reshape Gotham day to day?
What kind of plant does Frankette grow up to be under Ivy and Harley's care?

characters.name: Harley Quinn
characters.line: Fully reconciled with Ivy after moving to Metropolis; still saving the world when it calls for it.

characters.name: Poison Ivy
characters.line: Reaffirmed with Harley and freed from both the Legion and the Green Initiative; raising Frankette.

characters.name: Frankette
characters.line: The infant plant born from Frank's remains and Ivy's DNA; the couple's new dependent.

characters.name: Lena Luthor
characters.line: Shrunk and swallowed by Frankette after her bid to out-Lex her brother collapsed.

characters.name: Brainiac
characters.line: Made peace with the loss of his family and rode his own Skull Ship into planet Colu, dead.

characters.name: Bruce Wayne / Batman
characters.line: Dated Lena Luthor until her villain turn; still Metropolis-adjacent through Harley and Ivy.

characters.name: The Joker
characters.line: Alive, married, and back in the villain lane; part of Harley and Ivy's inner circle in Metropolis.

characters.name: Alfred Pennyworth
characters.line: Turned super-steroid villain at a dinner party and rearrested; back in confinement.

characters.name: Dick Grayson / Red X
characters.line: Resurrected assassin who let go of his grudge against Harley after Alfred's manipulation was exposed.

characters.name: Clayface
characters.line: Metropolis playwright whose Brainiac musical won the city's heart.
